The '''''Harken''''' was a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry (LAAT/i)]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] that saw service with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. ''Harken'' provided air support for [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], during which it destroyed an [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]] that had been threatening squad members [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]].<ref name="SWRC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gunship ''Harken'' first appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Personal Computer|PC]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox|Xbox]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', released in [[2005]]. Boss disembarks from the same gunship at the beginning of the level, but it is assumed to be a game mechanic and canonically different gunship as it is the only gunship model used in that level.
